prose: Basis: Bloomberg blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so this note rests on Techmeme's account. SpaceX has agreed to a roughly $40 billion equipment-finance lease with Apollo Global Management to fund purchases of Nvidia GPUs for its AI initiatives, with the deal set to close before the end of 2026. It is one of the largest chip-financing arrangements yet and a sign of how far private credit is reaching into the AI build-out.
